concept.title: Parent and family support
concept.shortdesc: Support, classes and information for parents and families, including antenatal and postnatal classes, baby feeding help and meeting other parents.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Meeting, chatting and connecting with other parents and carers for company and shared experience.
: Workshops, drop-ins, counselling and information helping parents with breastfeeding and feeding and caring for a new baby.
: Classes, groups and clinics for pregnancy, birth and the early weeks with a new baby, including antenatal courses, bump and baby yoga or fitness, and postnatal groups.
: Getting information, advice and support for whole families or children, young people and parents, including one-to-one family support.
